additions.name: WildManOne Huuhansuo data centre

status.summary: The Finnish Supervisory Agency received the environmental assessment programme for the proposed data centre. It describes a no-build option and two designs with maximum IT loads of about 320 MW and 480 MW.

locator.method: Transform the National Land Survey’s registered cadastral reference point from ETRS-TM35FIN (EPSG:3067) to WGS 84 (longitude, latitude).
locator.precision: Reference point on cadastral parcel 405-444-3-16, within the proposed campus in both alternatives.
locator.identity_review: Section 2.2 and figures 2-2 and 2-3 of the applicant’s environmental assessment programme place the parcel on the Kolmikannanmäki part of the proposed data-centre campus.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The cadastral service gives no measured horizontal error for the published reference point.

additions.distinctness_review: No WildManOne, Huuhansuo or matching cadastral identity appears in the canonical projects, sites, inherited source records or identity history. The nearest existing site is Nebius Pajarila Lappeenranta Campus (21.2 km away). The existing Nebius campus in Pajarila is a different development.
additions.successor_review: The assessment programme and the November consultation notice cover alternative designs for a single proposed development. The authority reports receipt of the programme and no construction approval.

additions.name: GreenSquareDC MEL1 — proposed Spotswood campus

status.summary: On November 24, 2026, Hobsons Bay City Council resolved to submit its concerns about the proposed Spotswood data centre to Victoria’s Department of Transport and Planning.

locator.method: Direct WGS84 Vicmap Address point for 44–76 Simcock Avenue, checked against allotment 78E in the planning application.
locator.precision: Representative civic address point on the proposed multi-building campus.
locator.identity_review: The registered point for the complete address range lies within Crown Allotment 78E, Section 7, Parish of Cut-Paw-Paw, explicitly included in the applicant’s title schedule.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Vicmap gives no surveyed campus-wide positional accuracy for this representative civic address.

additions.distinctness_review: One application covers ten proposed buildings at a single property. The GreenSquareDC SYD1 campus is in New South Wales. The nearest snapshot 188 site is NEXTDC M4 Melbourne Data Center Campus, 1.9 km away.
additions.successor_review: The Council referred its concerns to the state planning authority. The separate September permit allowed preliminary earthworks and did not approve data-centre development. No subsequent decision authorising the data centre was identified as of November 26.
